task_description: Elementwise y = x*scale + bias over a 1024x1024 bf16 array with the smallest legal block (8,128) versus a large block (128,1024).

metrics.name: num_grid_steps
metrics.description: Total pallas_call grid steps for the same array. Determined by block shape; each step carries fixed overhead.

metrics.name: achieved_tflops_pct_of_peak_bf16
metrics.description: Achieved TFLOPS as a percentage of v5e peak bf16 TFLOPS (197.0). Secondary signal; this kernel is overhead-bound, so grid step count and wall-clock time are more direct.
